name: Tesla Mixed Control
author: xpilot; dzid26; Haibin Wen and sunnypilot contributors
description: Angle-based cooperative steering: light driver torque adjusts the SP steering target with speed-dependent effort. SP must own steering; stock Autosteer must not steer at the same time (AP ownership/handoff is not implemented). Enable while parked, then restart. Overrides native TeslaCoopSteering mode for this session without changing its saved setting. Host-tested only; vehicle validation is pending.
